Thank you for your interest in dining at Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur. We offer a variety of dining experiences to suit your needs:

- Park Lounge: Offering breakfast (06:30 – 10:30), all-day dining (12:00 – 22:30), afternoon tea (14:30 – 17:30), and a bakery bar (12:00 – 20:00).
- Merdeka Grill: Our signature evening dining venue.
- Cacao: Our specialty outlet.
- In-room Dining: Available 24/7 for your convenience.

Please note that reservations for on-site dining are required. You may book your table by calling or messaging us via WhatsApp at +60 19 235 1234. I have attached our menus for your reference.

Warm regards,

Thank you for reaching out to Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur. We would be delighted to assist you with your inquiry.

Yes, our hotel features a stunning Sky Infinity Pool, located on level 99. The pool is heated and includes a vitality pool, sun loungers, and day beds, with lifeguards on duty for your safety. It is open daily from 07:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

We look forward to welcoming you soon.
